full_prompt_en: A square colorful editorial comic illustration shows a long nosed man leaning over a pale stone ledge and staring intently at a small bird. The man enters from the far left in close view, his elbows and clasped hands resting on the ledge. He wears a burgundy jacket, dark waistcoat, and round black glasses. His messy gray black hair, heavy brows, and sharply projecting nose give his face a curious, almost suspicious expression as he peers across the open space. Near the right center, a tiny plump brown bird stands on thin legs on top of the ledge, facing him. Its orange beak and a few spiky head feathers make it quietly comic. The stone parapet runs horizontally through the lower third, with small cracks and warm gray lines along its surface. At the left edge, the corner of an ornate cream building rises vertically, its carved cornices and narrow windows reduced to fine architectural marks. The remaining upper two thirds are a remarkably clear turquoise blue sky with a few soft white clouds near the distant right. Bright sunlight from high above warms the building and stone, while cool shadow under the man's sleeves and face adds depth. Fine ink outlines define hair, glasses, feathers, and cracks; smooth color and gentle hatching give volume to the figures. The huge open sky intensifies the absurdly serious face to face encounter, making the scene airy, witty, and sharply readable.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅方形彩色编辑漫画描绘一名长鼻男子伏在浅色石栏上，专注盯着一只小鸟。男子从最左近景探入，双肘和合拢的手压在栏顶。他穿酒红夹克、深色背心，戴黑色圆眼镜。凌乱灰黑发、浓眉和明显前伸的鼻子让表情好奇又近乎怀疑，他越过开放空间望向另一端。右侧中部附近，一只小而胖的棕鸟以细腿站在石栏顶，面向他。橙色鸟喙和几根翘起头羽添出安静喜剧感。石栏横过下方三分之一，表面有小裂纹和暖灰线条。左边缘，一栋华丽奶油色建筑的墙角竖直升起，雕刻檐口和窄窗简化成细建筑笔痕。其余上方三分之二是异常澄澈的绿松石蓝天空，远右附近有几团柔白云。高处明亮日光温暖建筑与石头，男子袖下和脸下的冷影添出纵深。细墨轮廓界定头发、眼镜、羽毛和裂纹；平滑颜色与轻排线赋予人物体积。巨大空天放大这场荒诞认真对视，使场景通透、机智且一眼可读。
style_prompt_en: Color editorial comic illustration uses precise lively ink contour, smooth tinted volume, and a striking field of open turquoise. A compact dark near mass at one side faces a tiny contrasting accent across a pale horizontal band. The rest of the frame stays spacious and bright, making the scale contrast immediate. Cream, burgundy, charcoal, warm brown, and clear cyan form a small vivid palette. Fine hatching appears under curved edges and within small textures, while broad planes remain clean and almost flat. High daylight brightens upper surfaces and puts modest cool shadow underneath. A narrow vertical structural edge anchors the left without cluttering the sky. The effect is playful, direct, and sharply legible, with comic tension generated by spacing, proportion, and focused attention.
style_prompt_zh: 彩色编辑漫画使用精准活跃墨线、平滑着色体积与醒目开放的绿松石色域。一侧紧凑深色近景体量隔着浅色水平带面对极小对比重音。画面其余部分保持宽阔明亮，让尺度反差立刻可见。奶油白、酒红、炭灰、暖棕和清澈青蓝形成鲜活小色域。细排线出现在弯曲边缘下与小肌理里，宽阔平面保持干净、近乎平涂。高位日光照亮上表面，下方留下适度冷影。一道窄竖向结构边固定左侧，却不挤占天空。效果活泼、直接且极易读，喜剧张力由间距、比例与集中的注意力生成。
